0: CONTRACT VALUE: USD 1,500,000,000 (One Billion Five Hundred Million Dollars) DURATION: 36 months (Completion: December 31, 2026) JURISDICTION: Taiwan with ICC Arbitration in Singapore SCOPE OF WORK: The Contractor shall design, procure, construct, install, test and commission a 150,000 sq meter semiconductor fabrication facility including: - 50 ASML EUV lithography machines (Netherlands) - 200 Tokyo Electron etching systems (Japan) - Applied Materials deposition tools (USA) - Samsung Electronics integration systems (South Korea) - Clean room facilities (Class 1 ISO standard) - Ultra-pure water treatment plant (100,000 m3/day capacity) - Electrical substation (500 MW capacity) - Chemical storage and distribution systems - Data center for fab automation (10 MW) CRITICAL SUPPLY CHAIN DEPENDENCIES: - ASML (Netherlands): EUV lithography - Route: Rotterdam → Suez Canal → Taiwan Strait → Kaohsiung Port - Tokyo Electron (Japan): Etching equipment - Route: Yokohama → East China Sea → Taiwan

1: INSURANCE COVERAGE: - Comprehensive General Liability: USD 100M - Contractor's All Risk (CAR): USD 1,500M - Marine Cargo Insurance: USD 1,000M - Delay in Start-Up (DSU): USD 200M - GAPS: No terrorism insurance, No political risk insurance, No war risk insurance, No cyber insurance mandated EXPORT COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS: - US Export Administration Regulations (EAR) compliance required - Dutch export license for ASML machines (subject to geopolitical review) - Wassenaar Arrangement controls on dual-use technology - Taiwan Technology Protection Act compliance - Immediate notification required if export licenses suspended or denied TERMINATION CONDITIONS: - Material breach with 30-day cure period - Insolvency or bankruptcy - Force Majeure exceeding 180 days - Government prohibition or export control denial - Owner termination for convenience: 90 days notice, costs plus 10% profit GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTES: - Taiwan Contract Law governs interpretation - ICC Arbitration in Singapore - 3 a
